situation: Trailing stop loss calculations were incorrect, causing positions to exit at wrong prices. PnL was being negatively impacted.
root_cause: In position_monitor.py, `get_dynamic_trailing_stop_pct` was called with only 2 arguments (pos, base_pct) but the function signature requires 3 (pos, base_pct, state). The missing `state` argument meant God Mode trailing stop tightening was never applied.
solution: Fixed the function call in position_monitor.py to pass all 3 required arguments including the offensive state object.
lesson: Always verify function call signatures when calling across modules. The offensive_guardrails.py functions often need the OffensiveState object to check God Mode, streak status, etc.

user_feedback.comments: Quick fix, trailing stops now calculating correctly
